_doc: Perguntas novas (source 'new') para treinar perguntas inesperadas. As respostas-modelo usam apenas fatos que estão no Word (campo 'facts' indica a origem). Nenhuma informação pessoal foi inventada.

new.a: I work at a bank as a Financial Planning Analyst.

new.q: How do you get to work?
new.a: I drive to work, and I usually accept Uber rides on my way to the office.

new.q: What time do you leave home?
new.a: On on-site days, I leave home at 5:45 a.m.

new.q: What do you usually have for breakfast?
new.a: I usually have a chicken sandwich, or fruit and oats.

new.q: Where do you park when you go to the office?
new.a: I park on the street near my gym.

new.q: What do you do at the gym?
new.a: I do ten minutes of cardio and a quick workout. On some days, I do a full weight-training session.

new.q: What time do you finish work?
What do you do when you get home?
new.a: I take a shower and have dinner with my family. We say a prayer before we eat.

new.q: What do you have for lunch at the office?
new.a: I bring my lunch from home in a lunch box and heat it up in the microwave.
Yes, I do. I play quick games online, and sometimes I play on a chessboard with my son.

new.q: What's the difference between your on-site days and your home office days?
new.a: On an on-site day, I go to the office and often go to the gym, whereas on a home office day, I work from home and usually skip the gym.
I play chess, watch an episode of a series with my family or relax on the sofa with my wife.
It's mentally demanding. I analyse profitability and prepare presentations for committee meetings.

new.q: When do you have your English classes?
new.a: I have online classes three times a week, at eleven p.m.

new.q: How do you study English in the car?
new.a: I listen to music, podcasts or audiobooks in English while I drive.

new.q: What do you usually do at the weekend?
new.hint: O Word não fala de fins de semana. Use ‘At the weekend, I usually…’ e escreva a sua resposta real em ‘Minha versão’.

keywords._doc: Ideias-chave por pergunta (sobrescrevem a extração automática). Cada grupo é aceito se qualquer forma aparecer.
